products.name: Premium Multi-Purpose Kitchen Organizer
products.short_description: Keep your kitchen neat and tidy with this versatile organizer.
products.description: This premium kitchen organizer helps you maximize storage space in your kitchen. Made from high-quality materials, it is durable and easy to clean.

products.name: Stainless Steel Spice Rack Set
products.short_description: Organize all your spices elegantly on your countertop or shelf.
products.description: A beautiful stainless steel spice rack that holds up to 12 spice jars. Perfect for modern Indian kitchens.

products.name: Car Seat Back Organizer with Tablet Holder
products.short_description: Keep your car neat and organized with this multi-pocket seat organizer.
products.description: This premium car seat back organizer features multiple pockets for tablets, bottles, books, and more. Easy to install and clean.

products.name: Universal Car Phone Mount (360 Rotation)
products.short_description: Securely mount your phone for navigation while driving.
products.description: 360-degree rotation car phone mount compatible with all smartphones. Easy one-hand operation and strong suction cup base.

products.name: Eco-Friendly Bamboo Cutting Board Set
products.short_description: Eco-friendly bamboo cutting boards in 3 versatile sizes.
products.description: Set of 3 premium bamboo cutting boards. Antibacterial, durable and easy to clean. Safe for all types of knives.

products.name: SonicWave Pro Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds
products.short_description: Active noise cancellation wireless earbuds with 32h playtime.
products.description: Studio-quality sound, deep bass, active noise cancellation, and seamless Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity.

products.name: AeroTech Studio Max ANC Wireless Headphones
products.short_description: Over-ear Hi-Res audio headphones with ultra-comfort earcups.
products.description: Premium wireless over-ear headphones with custom dynamic drivers and transparent ambient mode.
